newsitem.title: USA: Tandy's RadioShack expansion ahead of plan.
newsitem.headline: Tandy's RadioShack expansion ahead of plan.

text.p: Tandy Corp's RadioShack said Monday it is ahead of schedule in its plans to add about 100 company-owned and operated retail stores each year through 1999.
Since March 1995, the retail electronics chain has increased the number of company-owned stores by 266 for a U.S. total of 4,862, the company said.
"The store expansion program has surpassed our expectations," RadioShack President Leonard Roberts said in a statement.
"At this pace, we expect 276 new stores to be open by the end of 1996," he added. "We will continue to look for new store locations as long as market conditions warrant."
